description: Return the latest per-country physical dealer/retail gold prices — real quotes from dealers, mints, and bullion benchmarks, NOT spot-derived arithmetic — with nullable premium_over_spot_bps per quote (null when live reference inputs are unavailable). This tool returns gold quotes; where a country has dealer silver or platinum, read it on REST: /v1/physical/{country}?metal=silver or ?metal=platinum. `country` is an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. ID, MY, AE, JP). Uncovered countries return unknown_country on every plan. Requires Basic or higher; static sample responses for evaluation are in the docs at https://goldprice.dev/docs/physical.
name: get_physical_price
title: Get Physical Dealer Gold Prices
